title: CNA Now: Nvidia, Anthropic shares tumble as AI sell-off resumes, plus other news as it happens
snippet: Stay on top of the day's biggest stories with CNA Now, which brings you breaking news and major developments from Singapore and around the world.

title: China rocket blasts off on Shenzhou-24 mission: State media
snippet: The mission is crewed by spacecraft pilot Tang Hongbo, flight engineer Wu Yi and Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali.

title: Shanghai party pledges loyalty to Beijing as top official faces investigation
snippet: Shanghai's party chief Chen Jining, a member of China's elite Politburo, is under investigation for "suspected severe violations of discipline and laws".

She knew how to help children with dyslexia – but watching her own daughter struggle with it was different
snippet: From training educators to developing assessment tools, Dr Geetha Shantha Ram has helped advance dyslexia intervention in Singapore. Yet it was raising a daughter with the condition that gave her a deeper understanding of the emotional challenges faced by families.

title: Bellingham wondergoal helps Real thump PSV, Arsenal and Man City held
CNA Explains: What happens to your car warranty if a dealer shuts down in Singapore?
snippet: The abrupt closures of two Chinese EV dealerships in Singapore have raised concerns over vehicle warranties, servicing and consumer protection. CNA looks at what car owners should know when dealers exit the market.

title: PlayStation 5 sold out islandwide in race for gaming consoles after Grand Theft Auto VI release
snippet: Retailers are fielding dozens of queries a day, with no official word from Sony on when PS5 consoles will be back in stock.

title: Commentary: Why has a 10-cent deposit on beverage containers given Singaporeans so much to complain about?
snippet: Since its launch, it feels like not two weeks passes without the Beverage Container Return Scheme making the news. Writer Annie Tan explores why Singaporeans appear to be so triggered by these reverse vending machines.

title: Singapore scrap cars going for a steal in JB but some are finding their way back onto roads illegally
snippet: CNA found hundreds of online listings offering deregistered Singapore cars in Malaysia at bargain prices. Some sellers admit that buyers drive these cars illegally using cloned registration plates.

title: Commentary: Jensen Huang should never have been too big to fail at Nvidia
snippet: Nvidia may be too big to fail. Jensen Huang shouldn’t have been, says Dave Lee for Bloomberg Opinion.

title: Beyond the boutique: Chanel opens a dedicated atelier for luxury aftercare in Singapore
snippet: Chanel’s new Singapore atelier brings together skilled artisans and specialist aftercare services to help preserve cherished creations and extend their lifespan.

China's Huawei convicted in sprawling US criminal trial over Iran business
snippet: A Brooklyn federal jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 criminal counts over deceiving banks about Iran business and stealing US companies’ trade secrets.
